headlineFinding.context: The prior-cycle independent review of v3 logged a coordinator note: v3's doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone enumerates only two of its four leftoverDesign-true obligations (naming OBL-G19-FX-AUTHORING and OBL-GRANT-JOURNAL, omitting OBL-INHERIT-BLOCKED and OBL-MONOTONIC), and recent COORD entries in this run draw their Decision item 2 remainder sentence from exactly that field. The risk was that D-183 would quote it verbatim and under-report the remainder by half. The D-183 review prompt elevated this to an explicit attack line.
headlineFinding.tested: Parsed the draft by section and checked all four obligation IDs against v3's actual flag set.
headlineFinding.result: RISK DID NOT MATERIALIZE. v3's live leftover set is exactly the four; the draft names all four in three separate places — the header disclaimer (lines 18-19), the 'Why this entry exists' paragraph (lines 78-80), and Decision item 2 (lines 92-94) — scoring 4/4 in each. The entry took the complete flag-derived set rather than the subject's partial prose sentence.

The entry edits no cell, pairs the phrase with 'not QUALIFIED', and pins v3 by digest so v3's qualifier ('recording remains a later D-000 act') travels with it. Same construction as adopted siblings D-176 through D-182.
